item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei built a real protection regime for vulnerable groups. I also found no credible evidence of systematic protection from displacement or from intergroup/religious/ethnic violence. The closest positive signal is the temporary pause in the stricter hijab law’s implementation, but the broader record still shows coercion, harassment, and discriminatory punishment.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Amnesty documented widespread surveillance, mass police checks, car confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, and “morality” classes aimed at women and girls defying veiling rules.
